title: Cross-Cluster Decision Lens: Upgrades, Costs, and Network Tradeoffs (prototype)
creator: Marisol Chen
description:
Overview:
Design an interactive "Decision Lens" feature for the Private Console that overlays cross-cluster insights during rollout and upgrade planning. The Decision Lens synthesizes network fragility, SLA exposure, and incremental cost to deliver recommended windows and rollback sensitivity. This is a prototype to validate workflow assumptions with PM, Eng, and a small set of ops users.

Goals:
- Surface cluster-level signals that materially affect upgrade risk: inter-region bandwidth contention, egress bottlenecks, KV cache hit variance, and tenant SLO exposure.
- Show incremental cost delta for a proposed rollout plan (per-hour & projected 30-day) including estimated burst/billing scenarios for Dedicated-backed tenants.
- Provide an action-oriented UI: recommended canary slice, suggested maintenance window based on historical traffic patterns, rollback safety score, and one-click snapshot to create an ops runbook.
- Keep the UI lightweight and explorable: users should understand why a recommendation exists (trace to signals) and be able to adjust tradeoff sliders (cost vs. risk).

Prototype scope (MVP):
- Lens overlay in the cluster rollouts editor for Private/VPC clusters only.
- Risk heatmap aggregated at path, cluster, and tenant-slice levels.
- Cost delta estimator for CPU/GPU burst and egress changes; toggles for quantization/instance-size alternatives.
- Recommendation card (canary size, percent ramp, maintenance window) + rationale toggles.
- Export to Runbook (markdown) and create follow-up ENG issue action.

User flows to validate:
1) PM schedules an upgrade; Decision Lens shows a high-risk path between cluster A->B due to inter-region egress. Lens recommends a split rollout and a short maintenance window 02:00-04:00 PT.
2) Platform engineer toggles cost sensitivity slider to prioritize lower unit cost; Lens re-suggests using a smaller canary with longer ramp and flags a 12% latency regression risk.
3) On accept, the console creates a pre-filled runbook + checklist for ops and attaches the snapshot of metrics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype demonstrates: heatmap, cost delta, at least two signal-to-recommendation traces (e.g., KV cache hit drop -> reduce canary size; inter-region saturation -> split rollout).
- Usability test with 3 ops/platform engineers yields >80% of tasks completed without facilitator.
- PM and Eng sign-off on exported runbook format and recommended API fields for the rollout service.

Design decisions & trade-offs (current):
- We will surface simplified scores (0-100) for risk to avoid overwhelming users; detailed metrics exposed behind an "Expand" affordance. Trade-off: loses some raw telemetry but keeps the lens actionable.
- Cost estimator will use conservative upper-bound billing assumptions (95th percentile) to reduce underestimation risk; trade-off: may bias toward more cautious recommendations.
- Decision Lens runs client-side overlay to allow rapid exploration without blocking backend calls; heavy signals pre-aggregated by a new lightweight endpoint (ENG: ENG-91820).

Open questions:
- How granular should per-tenant recommendations be for multi-tenant Private clusters? (privacy vs. actionability)
- Do we expose predicted user-facing SLO impact as absolute minutes below threshold or percent degradation? (PM preference: minutes)
- Which RBAC scopes should see the lens by default? (ops, admin; not developer)

Links to artifacts:
- Figma prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/decision-lens-proto-2026 (view only)
- PRD (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLT/Decision+Lens+PRD
- Early engineering spike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1342
- Dashboard snapshot used in prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/cluster-lens/snap-2026-02-18

Next steps:
- 2026-03-14: Run moderated usability sessions (script attached in Confluence).
- 2026-03-18: Sync with ENG runtime: confirm required aggregated signals and latency SLO for endpoint (ENG-91820).
- 2026-03-22: Iterate prototype based on feedback and prepare handoff package for implementation.

Notes for engineering handoff (if greenlit):
- Endpoint contract: pre-aggregated heatmap, per-cluster cost_projection, per-tenant-slice safety_score, and a changelog of recent infra events. Keep payload < 200KB for quick fetch.
- Client behavior: optimistic UI with patch-based updates when users adjust sliders; require explicit "Save Rollout Plan" to persist.
- Accessibility: ensure colorblind-safe gradients for heatmap and provide numeric labels on hover.
comments: 2026-02-21 | Marisol Chen: Initial concept doc posted. Walked through sketch with PM and got alignment on goals. PM asked for explicit export format for runbooks.

2026-03-02 | Priya Iyer (PM): Reviewed prototype; asked for tighter copy on risk card and to include 'confidence' band in cost estimate. Also suggested defaulting lens to 'off' for non-admins.

2026-03-05 | Alex Romero (Platform Eng): Flagged backend dependency ENG-91820 for pre-aggregation. Suggested caching and differential fetch for quick UX. Mentioned potential 30s warmup for some signals.
2026-03-08 | Design Review (team): Usability checklist added. Agreed on 0-100 safety_score and detailed metric expanders. Decided to postpone per-tenant recommendations until privacy review.
2026-03-12 | Ethan Patel: Prototype updated with cost-sensitivity slider and 'explain' traces. Preparing test script for user sessions on 3/14.
2026-03-12 | Security (note): Security team requested a brief review if per-tenant IDs are surfaced. Added security_review_required=false for MVP but will revisit if tenant-level data is added.
